message:
The users API test now passes, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 fail.

The migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` read and wrote `full_name`. That mismatch caused the "unknown column users.full_name" error. I changed the API in `src/api/users.js` to use `fullname` and left `migrations/` alone, since the DBA team owns it and 001 is already applied in production.
